title: MGDilla - A Little Too Much
htmlContent:
Canadian-based singer and songwriter MGDilla releases a new track called "A Little Too Much". The single "A Little Too Much" is a mega record with a sound the world will love. It bridges the gap between high level artistry, and mass appeal to put it in a class of it’s own of must hear music. The song gives you everything you love from multiple genres, as well as it’s own original flavor to make it a song anyone can listen to, and find a reason to love it.

MGDilla puts all of his talent on full bloom to show he’s the real deal on the new song “A Little Too Much”. He genre blends at a high level to make one must hear sound that works to perfection. Be sure to follow him on all social media.
